## Question 
Is the average bill length different among penguin species?

## Citation
Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), based on data from Palmer Station LTER. License: CC-0

Package citation: Horst AM, Hill AP, Gorman KB (2020)
[palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3960218)


## Answer
```{python}
#| message: false
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
penguin_data = load_penguins()
penguin_data.head()
```

```{python}
mean_bill_length = penguin_data.groupby("species")["bill_length_mm"].mean()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-bill-length
#| fig-cap: "Average bill length by species."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
mean_bill_length.plot.bar()
plt.ylabel("Average bill length")
plt.show
```

Chinstrap penguins have the longest average flippers, followed by Gentoo penguins and then Adelie penguins.
